comparisons.name: console-light
comparisons.description: Console's icon-and-label toolbar, Aqua. Whole crop: stand-in glyphs and labels in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: console-light-layout
comparisons.description: As console-light with the glyphs, the labels and the window title masked, to score the bar's height, the bezels and their positions: the glyphs are application artwork and the text is set in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: console-dark
comparisons.description: Console's icon-and-label toolbar, Dark Aqua. Whole crop.

comparisons.name: console-dark-layout
comparisons.description: As console-dark with the glyphs and the labels masked.

comparisons.name: label-only-segments-light
comparisons.description: A segmented control in a label-only toolbar keeps its segments [provisional: no screenshot shows label-only mode]; the pixel is inside the first segment, which is the bar itself when the control is hidden.

pixels.note: inside the first segment: the bezel's fill gradient near its top, not the bar
